meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "check claude-mem", "mem search", "find past observations", "what did we do last session", or wants prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches the user's Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调出过往对话里与目标相关的记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常开多个会话，想搜回过往聊过的人、事或结论，免去重复询问。
copy.tagline_en: Pull up relevant records from your past conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run many sessions and want to recall people, tasks, or conclusions from past chats.

howto.what: 装上后，你问起以前的事时，Claude 会检索你在 cmem.ai 的 Claude-Mem 记忆库（过去会话留下的带时间戳记录），先宽泛搜索再收窄，最后用普通话把相关记录讲给你听，不直接甩原始输出。
howto.when: 当你提到 “search memory”、“mem search” 等关键词，或想了解上个会话关于某项目、决定、文件、任务的上下文时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜一下记忆里关于这个项目的记录
say.note: 先宽泛搜索，再收窄关键词

say.text: 上次会话我们做了什么？
查一下记忆里关于这个报错的历史记录
say.note: 若无结果会先检查 cmem 状态

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you ask about earlier work Claude searches your Claude-Mem memory on cmem.ai — timestamped observations from past sessions — running broad then narrow keyword passes and answering in plain language rather than dumping raw output.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "search memory", "mem search", or similar, or want prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task.

say_en.text: Search my memory for notes on this project
say_en.note: Broad pass first, then narrower terms

say_en.text: What did we do last session?
Look up past observations about this error
say_en.note: Runs a status check if nothing is found
